title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！
page_text_en:
Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and toward the right person, with the right degree of anger—that's difficult.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person, and in the right way.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills. Those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.
While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and development through experience. Early childhood is the golden period for cultivating emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create lasting neural connections in the brain, significantly influencing a child's physical and mental development.
Currently, reading emotional management picture books together with children is a widely recognized method for fostering these skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and growing with sunlight and rain.
This series of charming animal picture storybooks is warm and heartfelt. Each book focuses on a specific emotional topic for children, depicting their emotional journey and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a valuable reference for parents during shared reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful journey of parent-child reading together with this series!
summary_zh: 本页为《一只想飞的鸡》的出版者的话，阐述了情绪管理的重要性，强调幼儿时期是培养情绪管理能力的关键期，并介绍了该系列图画书的教育意义和亲子共读价值。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
老师对你说
保持一颗真诚的心
一只名叫露露的母鸡爱上了一只漂亮的信鸽沃拉。为了吸引心爱的沃拉，
她为自己缝制了一件斑鸠礼服，摇身一变，变成了“斑鸠莉莉白”。露露等
啊等，她等到自己的心上人了吗？这是一个寓言般的故事，情节跌宕起
伏。通过这个故事，孩子们能懂得人与人在交往时，必须保持一颗真诚的心。
故事中的小母鸡露露即使穿上了她的新衣服，变成了斑鸠的样子，也还
是一只母鸡，她根本不会飞。当摔得浑身青一块紫一块时，露露感叹道：“我
为什么要说谎呢？”明知自己太胡闹，露露还是想要和沃拉一起飞翔，结果
怎么样呢？当发现受到欺骗后，沃拉拍拍翅膀飞走了。露露的生活回到原点，
但她一点干劲儿都没有。是啊，母鸡就是母鸡，无论外表如何装扮，也变不
成斑鸠——欺骗换不来信任。故事并没有到此结束，创作者笔锋一转，当露
露已经不抱希望时，沃拉送来了一对定做的斑鸠翅膀，还是著名的家禽服装
设计师的作品呢！后来，小母鸡露露和信鸽沃拉终于可以比翼双飞，环游世
界了。故事终于画上了圆满的句号。我们在为小母鸡露露高兴的同时，也明
白了“我”就是“我”，在与人交往时，不需要伪装自己，不需要披上谎言
的外衣，只要捧出一颗真诚的心，自然就可以收获友情。
page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Keep a Sincere Heart
A hen named Lulu fell in love with a beautiful carrier pigeon, Wola. To attract her beloved Wola,
she sewed herself a pigeon dress, transformed into "Pigeon Lily White". Lulu waited
and waited, did she get her beloved? This is a fable-like story, full of twists and turns. Through this story, children can learn that when interacting with others, one must keep a sincere heart.
In the story, even though little hen Lulu put on her new clothes and looked like a pigeon, she was still
just a hen, and she couldn't fly at all. When she fell and was bruised all over, Lulu sighed: "Why
did I lie?" Knowing she was being foolish, Lulu still wanted to fly with Wola. What
happened? When Wola discovered he had been deceived, he flapped his wings and flew away. Lulu's life returned to its original state,
but she had no energy at all. Indeed, a hen is a hen; no matter how she dresses up, she can't
become a pigeon—deception brings no trust. The story doesn't end here. The author changes direction; when Lulu
had already lost hope, Wola sent her a pair of custom-made pigeon wings, designed by a famous poultry fashion
designer! Later, little hen Lulu and pigeon Wola could finally fly together, traveling around the
world. The story finally ends with a happy conclusion. While we rejoice for little hen Lulu, we also
understand that "I" is "I"; in social interactions, there's no need to disguise oneself, no need to wear a cloak of lies;
just offer a sincere heart, and friendship will naturally come.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《一只想飞的鸡》的导读页，以‘老师对你说’的形式，讲述了母鸡露露为追求信鸽沃拉而伪装成斑鸠，最终因欺骗失去信任，但在真诚与善意下获得圆满结局的故事，强调了保持真诚心的重要性。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
很多时候，孩子在与人交往时，只考虑结果如何，考虑能不能获得友情，而忽视采取哪种交往方式更合适。通过小母鸡露露的故事，家长可以让孩子明白：只有付出真诚，才能获得别人的信任。朋友在一起，最重要的，就是彼此真诚相待。

这本书用优美的文字和直观形象的图画，将成长的智慧传递给孩子。忙碌中的爸爸妈妈们，不妨抽出时间来，陪着孩子一起阅读吧！

（石家庄市第二幼儿园 谷红岩）
page_text_en:
Often, when children interact with others, they only consider the outcome—whether they can gain friendship—while ignoring which way of interacting is more appropriate. Through the story of little hen Lulu, parents can help children understand: only by offering sincerity can one earn others' trust. When friends are together, what matters most is being honest and sincere with each other.

This book uses beautiful words and vivid illustrations to pass on the wisdom of growing up to children. Busy parents, why not take some time to read along with your child?

(Shijiazhuang No. 2 Kindergarten, Gu Hongyan)
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的导读或推荐语，引用幼儿园教师的评语，强调通过小母鸡露露的故事，教导孩子在人际交往中要真诚相待，并鼓励家长陪伴孩子共读。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
一只叫露露的母鸡平静地生活在庞统诺农场。
她有一份不错的工作——为家禽缝制衣服。而且，
她的名气很大，谁的手艺都比不上她！
但是，露露有一个秘密，从来没有告诉过别人。
page_text_en:
A hen named Lulu lived peacefully on Pangtongnuo Farm.
She had a great job—sewing clothes for poultry. And,
her reputation was big; no one's skill could match hers!
But Lulu had a secret she had never told anyone.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了主角露露母鸡，她生活在庞统诺农场，以缝制家禽衣服为生，手艺高超，但有一个从未告诉别人的秘密。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面描绘了一只母鸡在缝纫机前工作的场景，她坐在桌前专注缝制，周围摆放着布料、线团和工具，背景是带有花纹的蓝色墙壁和储物柜，整体氛围温馨而充满手工创作的气息。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
她深爱着沃拉，那只漂亮的信鸽。每次旅行归来，
沃拉都会在鸡舍里歇歇脚。
page_text_en:
She deeply loves Wola, that beautiful carrier pigeon. Every time he returns from his travels,
Wola will rest his feet in the chicken coop.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了母鸡露露对信鸽沃拉的深情，她珍藏着沃拉的照片，每次沃拉旅行归来都会在鸡舍休息，画面充满粉色爱心，表现了露露对沃拉的爱慕之情。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
可是，露露一直认为，自己永远都不可能吸引到沃拉温柔的目光。她太害羞了。
而且，她觉得自己个子太小，身材又太胖了。
page_text_en:
However, Lulu always believed she could never attract Wola's gentle gaze. She was too shy.
Moreover, she thought she was too small and too fat.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了母鸡露露因害羞和对自己身材的不自信，认为自己无法吸引信鸽沃拉的注意，画面中露露站在体重秤上，周围环绕粉色花朵，突显其内心的自卑与纠结。

summary_zh: 画面中，母鸡露露和朋友们在鸡舍外，墙上贴着信鸽沃拉的照片和归期通知，露露显得有些紧张和期待，旁边一只母鸡发出“咕”的声音，暗示她对沃拉的思念与关注。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
一天晚上，农场里贴了一张海报，上面说信鸽沃拉就要回来了。
鸡舍里顿时乱成了一锅粥。母鸡们都激动坏了！
“沃拉旅行回来啦！”小羽毛兴奋地说。
“咕咕咕！我得好好打扮打扮。”科科特尖叫道。
“长着一身漂亮羽毛的信鸽沃拉就要到我们这里来啦！”母鸡们异口同声地说。
page_text_en:
One evening, a poster was put up on the farm, saying that the carrier pigeon Wola was coming back.
The chicken coop instantly turned into a mess. The hens were all excited!
"Wola is back from her trip!" Little Feather said excitedly.
"Gugu! I need to get myself all dressed up," Koko screamed.
"The carrier pigeon Wola, with her beautiful feathers, is coming to us!" the hens said in unison.
summary_zh: 农场贴出信鸽沃拉即将归来的海报，鸡舍里的母鸡们顿时兴奋不已，纷纷表达对沃拉的期待，有的想好好打扮，有的激动地欢呼。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露
高级
制衣
露露一下子多了好多活儿要做，因为所有的母鸡都想成为鸡群里最漂亮的那只。
这里缝一个鸡冠，那里缝三根羽毛，
她缝啊缝，缝啊缝，缝啊缝……
一刻都停不下来！
page_text_en:
Lulu
High-End
Tailoring
Lulu suddenly had so much work to do, because all the hens wanted to be the prettiest one in the flock.
Here she sews a comb, there she sews three feathers,
she sews and sews, sews and sews, sews and sews...
She can't stop for a moment!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了母鸡露露因农场母鸡们纷纷想成为最漂亮的那只，而忙得不可开交，她不停地为母鸡们缝制衣服，一刻也停不下来。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh: 当沃拉抵达农场时，所有的母鸡都盛装打扮。只有露露没有任何准备，因为她根本没有时间打扮自己。
page_text_en: When Wola arrived at the farm, all the hens were dressed up in their finest. Only Lulu had no preparation, because she simply didn't have time to dress herself.
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉抵达农场，其他母鸡都盛装打扮迎接，而露露因忙于为他人缝制衣服，毫无准备，显得格外落寞。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
面对这么多竞争者，露露发誓，她一定要变成最美丽的那只母鸡。
“你们走着瞧吧，我想到一个绝好的主意！我肯定，这样一来，沃拉就不会再无视我了！”
于是，她开始没日没夜地缝制新衣服。
page_text_en:
Faced with so many competitors, Lulu vowed she would become the most beautiful hen.
"You'll see, I've come up with a brilliant idea! I'm sure, this way, Wola won't ignore me anymore!"
So, she began sewing new clothes day and night.
summary_zh: 母鸡露露为了吸引信鸽沃拉的注意，决心成为最美丽的母鸡，并开始日夜缝制新衣服。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露终于做好了她的新衣服——一件又时尚又优雅的斑鸠礼服！
穿在身上，她觉得自己美极了！
page_text_en:
Lulu finally finished her new outfit — a fashionable and elegant pigeon gown!
Wearing it, she felt absolutely beautiful!
summary_zh: 露露完成了为自己缝制的新礼服，站在镜子前欣赏，感到自己非常美丽。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面中，信鸽沃拉从藤架上方俯视着下方的母鸡露露，露露手持紫色小伞，身着华丽礼服，站在铺有石砖的地面上，周围环绕着绿叶和粉色花朵，场景充满浪漫氛围。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露以为周围没有别人，就穿着新衣服走了出去。
突然，她听见身后有人跟她说话：
“我说小母鸡，你自己一个人在这儿干什么呀？”
她抬起头，发现是沃拉，心想：“他怎么认出我来呢？”
page_text_en:
Lulu thought no one was around, so she walked out wearing her new dress.
Suddenly, she heard someone speaking to her from behind:
"Hey little hen, what are you doing all by yourself here?"
She looked up and saw it was Wola, thinking to herself: "How did he recognize me?"
summary_zh: 露露穿着新衣服独自外出，意外被信鸽沃拉认出，内心惊讶于他如何认出自己。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面中，两只鸽子坐在公园长椅上，一只穿着紫色花纹裙子，另一只穿着红蓝条纹背心，它们正在亲密交谈。长椅上方有一只背着小提琴的甲虫，背景是绿色的植物和木制围栏，场景宁静而温馨。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
“您弄错了，先生，我是一只斑鸠，名字叫莉莉白。”
信鸽沃拉马上被她的魅力吸引住了。
“亲爱的莉莉白，今晚我就要离开这里了，三天之后才回来。
到时候，我希望还能见到你。”
露露，我们的小母鸡——“小斑鸠”眨了眨眼睛，低下头说：
“哦……那好呀……”
page_text_en:
"You've got it wrong, sir. I'm a turtledove, and my name is Lily White."
Wora the carrier pigeon was immediately captivated by her charm.
"Dear Lily White, I'm leaving here tonight and won't be back for three days.
I hope we can meet again then."
Lulu, our little hen—"Little Turtledove"—blinked her eyes and looked down, saying:
"Oh... that's fine..."
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉被名叫莉莉白的斑鸠吸引，并告知她自己即将离开三天，希望之后能再相见。母鸡露露（被称作‘小斑鸠’）听到后，低头轻声回应‘哦……那好呀……’，流露出复杂情绪。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
一天，两天，三天过去了，那个期待已久的夜晚终于来临了。
露露爬上鸡舍的屋顶，穿上斑鸠礼服，等待着她的心上人。
page_text_en:
One day, two days, three days passed, and the long-awaited night had finally arrived.
Lulu climbed onto the roof of the chicken coop, put on her dove dress, and waited for her beloved.
summary_zh: 露露在等待信鸽沃拉的三天后，穿上礼服爬上鸡舍屋顶，满怀期待地等待心上人的到来。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
沃拉飞来了，轻盈又优雅。

超级
帅鸽
page_text_en:
Wola flew in, light and graceful.

Super
Cool Pigeon
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉飞回来了，画面中他展翅飞翔，背景有心形云朵和羽毛，显得轻盈优雅，胸前挂着写有“超级帅鸽”的标签。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面中，一只紫色的鸽子闭着眼睛，面带幸福神情，周围漂浮着红色爱心，面前放着一个打开的红色礼盒，盒中有一枚金色戒指，象征着浪漫的求婚或告白场景。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
“我有一个请求，我最亲爱的莉莉白。”沃拉说着，向露露献上一枚金戒指。
“我们一起出发，去环游世界吧！我们一同飞翔，相亲相爱！”
露露犯愁了，因为她根本不会飞呀！唉，即使穿上她的新衣服，
也不能改变这一点啊！
“再等一两天好吗？”“小斑鸠”回答说。她心里难过极了，因为
说白了，她只是一只母鸡啊！
page_text_en:
"I have a request, my dearest Lily White," said Wola, presenting a golden ring to Lulu.
"Let's set off together, to travel the world! Let's fly together, loving each other!"
Lulu was worried, because she simply couldn't fly! Ah, even if she wore her new clothes,
that couldn't change a thing!
"Can we wait one or two more days?" replied the "little pigeon." She was heartbroken, because
after all, she was just a hen!
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉向露露求婚，邀请她一起环游世界，但露露因自己不会飞而感到难过和无奈，只能请求再等一两天。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露想飞起来，但试了好几次，都没有成功。还把自己摔得青一块紫一块的。
“我为什么要撒谎啊？”她感叹道，“我真是太可笑了，但我是真的爱他呀！”
page_text_en:
Lulu tried to fly, but after several attempts, she failed. She even ended up with bruises all over.
"Why did I lie?" she sighed, "I'm so ridiculous, but I really do love him!"
summary_zh: 露露尝试飞翔却屡次失败，摔得遍体鳞伤，她内心懊悔自己曾撒谎，但依然真诚地表达对信鸽沃拉的爱意。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
两天后，露露穿上她的斑鸠礼服，站在鸡舍的屋顶上等待沃拉。
信鸽沃拉划过天空，为心爱的恋人划出一圈圈大大的心形，然后
轻轻地落在她身边。
page_text_en:
Two days later, Lulu put on her pigeon dress and stood on the roof of the chicken coop, waiting for Wola.
The carrier pigeon Wola soared through the sky, drawing big heart shapes in the air for his beloved, and then
landed gently beside her.
summary_zh: 两天后，露露穿上礼服在鸡舍屋顶等待信鸽沃拉，沃拉在空中划出心形轨迹后轻盈降落到她身边，画面充满浪漫与期待。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh: 沃拉把翅膀环绕在“莉莉白”的脖子上，可“莉莉白”打了个嗝儿，一下子就失去了平衡……
page_text_en: Wola wrapped his wings around 'Lily White's' neck, but 'Lily White' let out a burp and immediately lost her balance...
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉试图拥抱斑鸠莉莉白，但莉莉白打了个嗝导致两人失去平衡，画面中两只鸟在屋顶上摇晃，旁边有一只瓢虫在飞。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh: 她重重地跌落在地上，身上的斑鸠礼服也被扯破了。
page_text_en: She fell heavily to the ground, and her spotted dove dress was torn.
summary_zh: 露露尝试飞翔失败，重重摔在地上，礼服也被扯破，画面中她狼狈地倒地，旁边有警示牌和瓢虫。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
沃拉发现受到了欺骗，拍拍翅膀飞走了，看都没看一眼那只既羞愧又悲伤的母鸡露露。
接下来的几天，谁都没有听到信鸽的消息。
page_text_en:
Wola realized he had been deceived, flapped his wings, and flew away, not even glancing at the hen Lulu, who was both ashamed and sorrowful.
In the following days, no one heard any news of the carrier pigeon.
summary_zh: 信鸽沃拉发现被露露欺骗后伤心飞走，露露独自伤心落泪，之后几天再无信鸽消息。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh: 露露又做起了裁缝的活计，但一点干劲儿都没有。
page_text_en: Lulu started sewing again, but she had no energy at all.
summary_zh: 露露在房间里做裁缝，但毫无干劲，显得心事重重。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
一天晚上，母鸡们正准备睡觉时，鸡舍的门突然打开了。
沃拉一言不发地走到露露面前，递给她一个长方形的包裹。
缝纫机
page_text_en:
One evening, as the hens were getting ready to sleep, the door to the chicken coop suddenly opened.
Wola silently walked up to Lulu and handed her a rectangular package.
Sewing machine
summary_zh: 一天晚上，信鸽沃拉悄悄来到鸡舍，向露露递上一个长方形的包裹，而露露正坐在缝纫机旁，神情落寞。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露颤抖着打开了包裹。
天哪！是一对定做的斑鸠翅膀，上面还有布雷多——那个著名的
家禽服装设计师的签名！
“这对翅膀太美了！”露露激动地说。
“听着，亲爱的，尽管我们并不相同，但最重要的是……我爱你！”
page_text_en:
Lulu trembled as she opened the package.
Wow! It was a pair of custom-made pigeon wings, with a signature from Breedo—the famous poultry fashion designer!
“These wings are so beautiful!” Lulu said excitedly.
“Listen, my dear, even though we are not the same, the most important thing is… I love you!”
summary_zh: 露露打开信鸽沃拉送来的包裹，发现是一对定制的斑鸠翅膀，上面还有著名设计师的签名，她激动地表达感谢，沃拉则深情告白，两人重归于好。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh:
露露穿上翅膀，来到屋顶边缘，心跳得怦怦响。
沃拉鼓励她：“来吧，亲爱的，拍动你的翅膀，带着我的爱飞翔吧！”,
page_text_en:
Lulu put on the wings and stood at the edge of the roof, her heart pounding.
Wola encouraged her: "Come on, my love, flap your wings and fly with my love!"
summary_zh: 露露穿上翅膀站在屋顶边缘，心跳加速，信鸽沃拉在一旁鼓励她勇敢飞翔。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
page_text_ocr_zh: 听了这些话，露露展开翅膀，从屋顶滑了下去。
page_text_en: After hearing these words, Lulu spread her wings and slid down from the roof.
summary_zh: 露露在听到鼓励后，展开翅膀从屋顶滑下，准备尝试飞翔。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面中，一只信鸽在蓝天中飞翔，爪子牵着一串粉色心形气球，气球随风飘动，背景是淡蓝色的天空和几缕白云，营造出浪漫温馨的氛围。

她在空中拍打了几下翅膀，飞到爱人身旁。

In Pangtongnuo Farm, everyone said they had flown around the Earth together for three full circles.

summary_zh: 露露和信鸽沃拉在空中比翼双飞，飞向远方，庞统诺农场的居民们传说他们已绕地球飞行三圈，画面充满浪漫与幸福。

title_en: A Chicken Who Wanted to Fly
summary_zh: 画面中，一只蓝色的信鸽站在粉色波点背景前的镜子前，正低头整理自己新装的翅膀，镜中映出它戴着眼镜、神情专注的倒影，翅膀上有缝线痕迹，暗示其为定制或修补的飞行装备。
